concealed_damage_flags.rationale: Water staining/mould on a ceiling indicates a leak above (roof, plumbing, upstairs wet room); the cavity above is likely wet. Inspect and moisture-test the void before repair.

scope.action: mould remediation incl. 0.3 m margin, biocide wash

notes: Ceiling not observed: ceiling heights are priors (observed=false) with wide intervals.
Video tier: poses from COLMAP SfM on RGB only; metric scale from Depth-Anything-V2 metric-indoor (bias-corrected x1.072); intervals include a 4% relative scale term.

Damage: classical candidates + CLIP ViT-B/32 zero-shot classification (no damage-specific training); confidence = CLIP probability. Scope: quantities only; pricing intentionally omitted (use local rate tables).
